audit_note: Never trust archive folder names: filter every sample by actid. The current partial training/evaluation inventory contains train_GRD/shard-00001, train_GRD/shard-00002, and test_GRD/shard-00000. Their observed event IDs are 118, 130, 147, 174, 205, 267, 273, 275, 277, 1111004, 1111005, 1111006, 1111007, 1111008, 1111009, and 1111010; all map to the pinned author split and no unknown IDs were found. The subset includes author-train, validation, and test events, so the partial-subset training/evaluation guards can run. Nine events are stored under a directory whose name disagrees with their author split. The separately audited train_GRD/shard-00004 scout contains held-out test event 1111013 and is not in this training inventory. The full inventory has not been downloaded or audited.
